_comment: What the Agora Conversational AI Engine POSTs to A's shim. URL used: POST {PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/v1/chat/completions?call_id=call-urgent-exam. The call_id query param is set by A when it starts the agent (fallback: a system message 'RESOLVIX_CALL_ID=<id>'; see Spike S1). Extra fields Agora may send (context, tools, modalities, stream_options) must be accepted and ignored.

messages.content: Namaste, aap college helpline par hain. Main AI sahayak hoon, yeh call record ho sakti hai. Batayiye, kya madad karun?
Exam 15 minute mein hai, room nahi mil raha!
Ye urgent lag raha hai. Aapka roll number aur paper ka naam batayiye.
